summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust filed an Item 8.01 current report disclosing its monthly net asset value and the resulting transaction price for each share class, effective November 1, 2026. NAV as of September 30, 2026 totaled $1.472 billion across 58.4 million shares, with per-share NAV ranging from $24.8417 (Class D) to $26.1978 (Class F). The filing also notes material events since quarter-end could affect NAV. This is a routine non-traded REIT NAV/pricing update, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or board recommendation are stated.
